title: Eric Lopes and the second capture of a live creature

tellings.quote: right Eric Lopes and he was the alleged driver during the second capture of one of the alive creatures

Roughly 3 hours after the girls witnessed the strange creature, military police officers Eric Lopes and Marco Cherzi drive down this road on the lookout for something unusual when suddenly it runs right across their path.

as_told.title: Military police officers Eric Lopes and Marco Chereze capture the creature

plain: James Fox, a documentary filmmaker who investigates UFO cases, tells of a military police officer named Eric Lopes in the Brazilian town of Varginha in 1996, who is said to have been the driver when a second living creature was captured. In a later telling Fox dates it to January 20, 1996, about three hours after three girls reported seeing a strange creature, and says the creature ran across the road in front of Lopes and his fellow officer Marco Chereze. If true, it would mean the military caught a live, non-human being.
